local_review.method: Local review of saved TinyFish HTML and ordinary public primary-source web/PDF checks
local_review.summary: Five saved selections reviewed without a new provider operation. Claim-level support is distinguished from observed attribution links, producer-authored sources and unresolved earliest authorship.
limitations: This is a local review layered on the original recorded batch, not another TinyFish Research or Fetch result.
The batch does not establish five complete earliest-origin trails.
Ordinary web/PDF checks have day precision. Saved TinyFish capture timestamps remain unchanged.
The full installed-extension journey is not established by this review.
